[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant listed the following Domestic Thrillers: "The Couple Next Door" by Shari Lapena, "The Wife Between Us" by Greer Hendricks and Sarah Pekkanen, and "The Last Mrs. Parrish" by Liv Constantine.

[PREFERENCE] User finds the thriller recommendations helpful and is interested in reading more thrillers.
